summary: Comprehensive testing of MentoriQ platform updates - Iteration 3. All new admin features (user management, purchases, blog with URL links) working correctly. Emergent badge removed. Course detail page working.
passed_tests: Emergent badge removed - no 'Made with Emergent' badge found on any page
Admin login works - admin@mentoriq.com / Admin@123 redirects to /admin
Admin Dashboard shows 6 tabs: Overview, Courses, Purchases, Users, Testimonials, Blog
Admin Users tab - displays list of all users with name/email/role/created_at/delete actions
Admin Create User - form opens, fills correctly, creates user with toast notification
Admin Delete User - confirmation dialog, deletes user, removes from list with toast
Admin Purchases tab - shows Purchase History with Total Revenue display
Admin Purchases empty state - shows 'No purchases yet' message (expected - no real payments)
Admin Blog tab - shows Blog Articles management with Add Blog Article button
Admin Create Blog with URL link - form has External URL Link field and PDF upload option
Admin Blog Link badge - blogs with read_more_link show 'Link' badge
Admin Edit Blog - opens edit dialog with pre-filled data, updates successfully
Admin Delete Blog - confirmation dialog, deletes blog with toast notification
Landing page AI Knowledge Hub - displays blog articles from API
Landing page blog Read More - links to read_more_link URL for blogs with links
Course detail page - loads correctly with Enrollment Options, Course Syllabus, Instructor
Backend API: Admin login (200)
Backend API: GET /api/admin/users (200, returns user list)
Backend API: POST /api/admin/users (200, creates user)
Backend API: DELETE /api/admin/users/{id} (200, deletes user)
Backend API: GET /api/admin/purchases (200, returns purchase list)
Backend API: GET /api/admin/stats (200, returns platform stats)
Backend API: POST /api/admin/blogs with read_more_link (200)
Backend API: PUT /api/admin/blogs/{id} (200, updates blog)
Backend API: DELETE /api/admin/blogs/{id} (200, deletes blog)
Backend API: Unauthorized access returns 401 for admin endpoints
critical_code_review_comments: Admin user management properly validates role (student/teacher/admin only)
Admin cannot delete their own account (self-delete protection)
Blog form supports both PDF upload and URL link for Read More
Purchases endpoint enriches data with user_name, user_email, course_title
Razorpay live keys configured in backend/.env (rzp_live_*)
seed_data_creation: Test users and blogs created and cleaned up during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new admin features are working: Users tab (create/delete), Purchases tab (empty state shown - no real payments yet), Blog tab (supports both PDF upload and URL links). Emergent badge completely removed from index.html. Razorpay is using LIVE keys. Course detail page working correctly.
